mapper.sql: id, agent_key, user_id, session_id, channel_type, title, created_at, last_active_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_channel_session (agent_key, user_id, session_id, channel_type, title) VALUES (#{agentKey}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{channelType}, #{title}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_active_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , title = COALESCE(title, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_channel_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_channel_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}
